text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77k with modest gains, while Ethereum and altcoins are outpacing it with stronger 24-hour momentum, suggesting some rotation into alts. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 63 but has declined 10 points over the week, indicating sentiment peaked recently and traders are becoming more cautious. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.2% with $101B in daily volume shows healthy overall market activity, though the broader rally lacks the conviction of earlier strength.
